items.headline: RBI adopts 'wait-and-watch' approach despite inflation rise
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is maintaining a cautious stance on policy rates. While headline CPI inflation rose to 4.45% in July, core inflation remained stable at 3.9%. The RBI's MPC minutes suggest a potential rate hike later in 2026 if inflation persists, but steady rates are broadly expected through 2026, with FY27 CPI projected at 4.8%. India's robust macroeconomic fundamentals are cushioning the economy.

items.headline: US Tech Rally and Softer Crude Prices Boost Global Sentiment
items.summary: Global markets were influenced by positive US cues, including a strong performance from technology companies following Nvidia's results. US markets closed higher, with the Nasdaq advancing 1.57%. Brent crude futures softened to $89.45 a barrel, while WTI stood at $83.31. Investors await Fed Chief Kevin Warsh's speech at Jackson Hole.

items.headline: Nifty Q1 FY27 Earnings Driven by Key Companies; ICICI Bank Shows Strong Growth
items.summary: The top five companies contributing over 60% to the Nifty's Q1 FY27 earnings increment were ONGC, Hindalco Industries, Reliance Industries, JSW Steel, and Bharti Airtel. ICICI Bank reported a 15.9% year-on-year growth in Profit After Tax (PAT) to ₹14,805 crore in Q1 FY27.

items.headline: IT, Realty, and Media Stocks Rally; FMCG and Chemicals Retreat
items.summary: IT stocks led the market rally, with the Nifty IT index jumping 3.03% on positive global sentiment. Realty and Media indices also saw gains. In contrast, the Nifty FMCG index lost 0.17% and Chemicals shares retreated, while banking and financial services showed mixed movements.

items.headline: Tempsens Instruments IPO debuts with 111% premium
items.summary: Tempsens Instruments made a strong market debut, listing at ₹634 apiece on the NSE, a 111% premium over its issue price of ₹300.

items.headline: Alpha Wave Ventures to sell stake in Lenskart Solutions
items.summary: Alpha Wave Ventures is reportedly planning a block deal to sell a 1.2% stake in Lenskart Solutions, valued at approximately ₹1,313 crore.

items.headline: Texmaco Rail signs MoU with Germany's BVV
items.summary: Texmaco Rail and Engineering Ltd. signed an MoU with Bochumer Verein Verkehrstechnik GmbH (BVV) for potential collaboration in railway components.

items.headline: Tejas Networks secures ₹1,537 crore order from TCS for BSNL 4G
items.summary: Tejas Networks Ltd. received a Letter of Intent (LoI) from Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) to supply RAN equipment for BSNL's 4G mobile network across 18,685 sites, an order valued at ₹1,537 crore.

items.headline: NBCC (India) secures multiple construction orders
items.summary: NBCC (India) Ltd. secured construction orders totaling ₹134.27 crore from various government and banking entities.

items.headline: Chemplast Sanmar appoints Ganeshkumar Subramanian as MD
items.summary: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd. announced the Ministry of Corporate Affairs' approval for Ganeshkumar Subramanian as its Managing Director for three years, effective April 1, 2026.

items.headline: IT Majors, Power Grid, Titan among top gainers
items.summary: Key gainers included Tata Consultancy Services, Tech Mahindra, Infosys, HCL Technologies, LTIMindtree, Titan, Power Grid, Wonderla Holidays, Bharat Heavy Electricals, Adani Power, Global Health, Sona BLW Precision Forgings, and Laurus Labs.

items.headline: Cement, Banking, Auto, and FMCG stocks among losers
items.summary: Notable losers included UltraTech Cement, ICICI Bank, Mahindra & Mahindra, State Bank of India, Adani Energy Solutions, CG Power & Industrial Solutions, Adani Green Energy, Shree Cements, ITC, and Asian Paints.
